name: limit_marking_without_depth
why: Depth zero. SOLIDWORKS on a cut of zero length does nothing and does not complain: the feature is either not born, or born and removes not a cubic millimetre. In both cases the plan goes on believing that the serial number is there. Here it is refused beforehand, and it is said that an annotation without a feature is something else -- because that is almost always what whoever wrote zero really wanted.
